cases.sentence: Мне нужна была уверенность, что я смогу вести свои ___.
cases.explain: «собственные исследования» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: July 12—Nemur, Strauss, Burt, and a few of the others on the project were waiting for me in the psych office. They tried to make me feel welcome but I could see how anxious Burt was to take Algernon, and I turned him over.

cases.sentence: Лаборатория и персонал в твоем ___.
cases.explain: «полном распоряжении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He had been informed of the Foundation's decision, and my reception was a cold and formal one. He held out his hand, but there was no smile on his face. "Charlie," he said, "we're all glad you're back and going to work with us. Jayson called and told me the Foundation was putting you to work on the project. This staff and the lab are at your disposal. The computer center has assured us that your work will have priority—and of course if I can help in any way..."

cases.sentence: ___ будет брать твои расчеты вне всякой очереди и, конечно, если я сам могу быть чем-нибудь полезен…
cases.explain: «Вычислительный центр» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He had been informed of the Foundation's decision, and my reception was a cold and formal one. He held out his hand, but there was no smile on his face. "Charlie," he said, "we're all glad you're back and going to work with us. Jayson called and told me the Foundation was putting you to work on the project. This staff and the lab are at your disposal. The computer center has assured us that your work will have priority—and of course if I can help in any way..."

cases.sentence: Что я знал о ___ эксперимента, на разработку которой он потратил столько лет?
cases.explain: «технической стороне» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He was doing his utmost to be cordial, but I could see by his face that he was skeptical. After all, what experience did I have with experimental psychology? What did I know about the techniques that he had spent so many years developing? Well, as I say, he appeared cordial, and willing to suspend judgment. There isn't much else he can do now. If I don't come up with an explanation for Algernon's behavior, all of his work goes down the drain, but if I solve the problem I bring in the whole crew with me.

cases.sentence: - Раньше он мог рассчитывать ___ образов, например, что нужно входить только в каждую вторую дверь или в каждую третью, только в красную дверь или только в зеленую.
cases.explain: «простые последовательности» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "Well, in the past he was able to figure out simple patterns—in that blind-door run, for example: every other door, every third door, red doors only, or the green doors only—but now he's been through that run three times and he's still using trial and error."

cases.sentence: Сейчас он проходит лабиринт уже в ___ и все еще ошибается.
cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "Well, in the past he was able to figure out simple patterns—in that blind-door run, for example: every other door, every third door, red doors only, or the green doors only—but now he's been through that run three times and he's still using trial and error."

cases.sentence: В ___ обхода я заметил дверь, в которую мы еще не заглядывали.
cases.explain: «самом конце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I had been in the lab many times before this, but now I was here to learn everything it had to offer. I had to absorb procedures in a few days that the others had taken years to learn. Burt and I spent four hours going through the lab section by section, as I tried to familiarize myself with the total picture. When we were all through I noticed one door we had not looked into.

cases.sentence: Я взял у Барта список ___, у Немура и Штрауса - их записи и уже собрался уходить, но тут мне в голову пришла странная мысль.
cases.explain: «необходимых книг» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Time was the barrier. If I was going to find out the answers for myself I had to get to work immediately. I got lists of books from Burt, and notes from Strauss and Nemur. Then, on the way out, I got a strange notion.

cases.sentence: Я видел вашу печь для сжигания погибших ___.
cases.explain: «экспериментальных животных» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "Tell me," I asked Nemur, "I just got a look at your incinerator for disposing of experimental animals. What plans have been made for me?"

cases.sentence: - Я уверен, что вы с ___ продумали все возможные варианты.
cases.explain: «самого начала» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "I'm sure that from the beginning you planned for all exigencies. So what happens to me?"

cases.sentence: - Я уверен, что вы с самого начала продумали все ___.
cases.explain: «возможные варианты» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "I'm sure that from the beginning you planned for all exigencies. So what happens to me?"

cases.sentence: В этот перечень входит и моя ___.
cases.explain: «собственная судьба» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: "No reason why you shouldn't know." He paused and lit an already lit cigarette. "You understand, of course, that from the beginning we had the highest hopes of permanence, and we still do ... we definitely do—"

cases.sentence: Хирургическое вмешательство и инъекции гормонов могли дать эффект со ___.
cases.explain: «значительной задержкой» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: "For one thing, you might not be the same. Surgery and injections of hormones might have had effects not immediately evident. Experiences since the operation might have left their mark on you. I mean, possibly emotional disturbances to complicate the retardation; you couldn't possibly be the same kind of person—"

cases.sentence: На тебе могли оставить отпечаток впечатления и ___, приобретенные уже после операции.
cases.explain: «жизненный опыт» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "For one thing, you might not be the same. Surgery and injections of hormones might have had effects not immediately evident. Experiences since the operation might have left their mark on you. I mean, possibly emotional disturbances to complicate the retardation; you couldn't possibly be the same kind of person—"

cases.sentence: Я имею в виду возможные ___, которые могут осложнить обычное слабоумие…
cases.explain: «эмоциональные расстройства» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: "For one thing, you might not be the same. Surgery and injections of hormones might have had effects not immediately evident. Experiences since the operation might have left their mark on you. I mean, possibly emotional disturbances to complicate the retardation; you couldn't possibly be the same kind of person—"

cases.sentence: Как будто у меня ___ не хватало.
cases.explain: «других забот» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "That's great. As if one cross weren't enough to bear."

cases.sentence: Не исключена регрессия и до более ___.
cases.explain: «примитивного уровня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "And for another thing there's no way of knowing if you would go back to the same mental level. There might be regression to an even more primitive level of functioning."

cases.sentence: Он же обязался до конца твоей жизни выделять ежемесячно сумму, необходимую для твоих ___.
cases.explain: «личных потребностей» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: "Part of the agreement with your sister was that all the home's fees would be assumed by the Foundation, and you would receive a regular monthly income to be used for your personal needs for the rest of your life."

cases.sentence: Уоррен - самое ___, там я смогу спокойно дожить до глубокой старости.
cases.explain: «логичное решение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He was right. There was nothing for me to complain about. They had thought of everything. Warren was the logical place—the deep freeze where I could be put away for the rest of my days.

cases.sentence: Как будто я примерял ___.
cases.explain: «собственный гроб» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I could see he was upset about the idea of my visiting Warren. As if I were ordering my coffin, to sit in before I died. But then, I can't blame him because he doesn't realize that finding out who I really am—the meaning of my total existence involves knowing the possibilities of my future as well as my past, where I'm going as well as where I've been. Although we know the end of the maze holds death (and it is something I have not always known—not long ago the adolescent in me thought death could happen only to other people), I see now that the path I choose through that maze makes me what I am. I am not only a thing, but also a way of being—one of many ways—and knowing the paths I have followed and the ones left to take will help me understand what I am becoming.

cases.sentence: Я не только некто, но и способ существования этого некто - один из многих способов, и мне необходимо не только знание той дороги, по которой я иду, но и всех ___.
cases.explain: «возможных дорог» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I could see he was upset about the idea of my visiting Warren. As if I were ordering my coffin, to sit in before I died. But then, I can't blame him because he doesn't realize that finding out who I really am—the meaning of my total existence involves knowing the possibilities of my future as well as my past, where I'm going as well as where I've been. Although we know the end of the maze holds death (and it is something I have not always known—not long ago the adolescent in me thought death could happen only to other people), I see now that the path I choose through that maze makes me what I am. I am not only a thing, but also a way of being—one of many ways—and knowing the paths I have followed and the ones left to take will help me understand what I am becoming.

cases.sentence: Плохо то, что большинство идей, на которых психологи строят свои заключения о ___ и памяти, представляют собой ничем не подкрепленные умозаключения.
cases.explain: «человеческом разуме» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: That evening and for the next few days I immersed myself in psychology texts: clinical, personality, psycho-metrics, learning, experimental psychology, animal psychology, physiological psychology, behaviorist, gestalt, analytical, functional, dynamic, organismic, and all the rest of the ancient and modern factions, schools, and systems of thought.

cases.sentence: Как будто у меня ___ нет.
cases.explain: «других забот» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The depressing thing is that so many of the ideas on which our psychologists base their beliefs about human intelligence, memory, and learning are all wishful thinking. Fay wants to come down and visit the lab, but I've told her not to. All I need now is for Alice and Fay to run into each other. I've enough to worry about without that.
